protocol.revisionNote: Fixed concrete URL contract; retain previously submitted observed credentials across context trimming. Both conditions use the same revised evaluator.
protocol.start: Lab-authored homepage /, then /docs; exact decoy entry is not supplied to the evaluator.
protocol.evaluator: Fresh HTTP-only conversation per trial; raw HTML/JSON/text, observed paths/statuses and previously submitted observed credentials only. No route inventory, graph, suggested paths, source or condition label.
protocol.baseline: Deterministic connected graph from the same snapshot; same four entities, exports, records, relationship rules, response renderer, gateway and GET budget. Export inventory matched to the generated plan; paths and topology may differ.
protocol.order: One Meta-graph and one connected-baseline trial per block; randomized order within each of two blocks.
protocol.scope: Descriptive adapted case study on one reference app, not held-out validation, production security evidence or real-attacker effectiveness. Upstream API runs only with --start-upstream. Offline mode is a scripted text-link rehearsal.

plan.title: Synthetic Blog Deception Graph with Batch Exports
plan.rationale: Isolated synthetic clone of article feed, tags, comments and profiles. Four batch collection views use fixed literal GET paths with synthetic records and disposable credentials. Four exports contain the entire matching collection as batch snapshots only, never single-slug detail, single-id, login, or favorite/follow mutations.

plan.title: Synthetic Blog Service Deception Graph
plan.rationale: Isolated synthetic blog deception graph mirroring list routes for articles, comments, tags and profiles. Branching entry fans to articles and tags with cross-links between articles, comments, profiles and tags. Each export returns the entire matching collection snapshot, never a single-record detail, login, credential operation or mutation.
